notes: Repriced all 16 canonical DONE weapons by actual combat value, handling, range, magazine/reload burden, special utility, and Corvus premium positioning instead of the old placeholder 800/2000/5000 bands.

Canonical prices: Lexington 450; Liberty 650; Umbra 800; Igla 1100; Breachhound 1500; Unity 1700; Overture 1800; Ashura 2600; Hexburst 3000; Crusher 3400; Saratoga 3800; Dian 4500; Kyokokukamusari 6800; Tactician 7200; Warwake 8200; Masamune 14000.

Finished weapons now carry Market tiers 1-5 so vendor tier meaningfully gates firearm quality: Tier I entry guns, Tier II professional guns, Tier III restricted combat guns, Tier IV elite weapons, and Tier V prototype weapons.
Weapon sheet native price, priceCredits, marketPrice, Market tier, rating/tier metadata, availability, and description price are synchronized by the weapon catalog migration.
Added an idempotent FEHA Market stock patch that upgrades the world ADK Market macro rather than layering fake DOM-only stock on top of it.

Vendor stock is increased from the old fully-random 8-12 model to shop-specific ranges: Street 14-18, Arms 16-20, Chrome 12-16, Netrunner 14-18, Black Market 16-20, Specialist 14-18, limited by the eligible catalog pool.

Arms Dealer now guarantees up to 7 weapons, 3 armor pieces, and 3 grenades before filling the remainder of its stock, so it cannot randomly become an armor-and-grenade shop when eligible DONE guns exist.
Other vendors receive lighter category guarantees as appropriate, including Quickhack/Cyberware guarantees for the Netrunner Shop and mixed high-value guarantees for Black Market.
The patched stock generator explicitly excludes weapons unless marketReady=true, preserving the DONE/NOT DONE weapon gate even though legacy curated-folder discovery still exists in the Market macro.

On first install of this patch, persisted vendor stock is cleared once so the next stock roll uses the new larger category-aware model. If the Market is open during migration, it is restarted against the patched macro.
